abi.return_contract: the low byte of EAX carries the accept flag; the wide EAX bits are scratch for the record keys and are not an answer

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the opaque span fields and the descriptor word at 0x44
all twenty seven ports are dependency-only, so the record assembly is unverified in this package
the 0x011f0440 fill and 0x005f8ed0 record ports are called with opaque word triples whose runtime meaning is undecoded
the two insert ports 0x005fa0a0 and 0x005fa0d0 are distinguished only by the block they are handed, and their class owners are unresolved
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reports the answer as a full dword; the assembly writes only AL through SETNE or MOV, so the model returns the widened byte
the release of the opened handle through 0x005f7970 is conditional on the second insert, and the staging model made it unconditional; the corrected model keeps the guard
the descriptor at receiver + 0x44 is read once and reused for both the resolve and the write ports, not re-read per port
